description: The brand consistency and asset approval checklists from references/brand/. Applies to anything carrying the brand.

gates.title: Correct Logo Variant For Its Background
gates.rule: The variant that suits the surface it sits on - full colour, mono, or reversed - never the light logo dropped on a light background.

gates.title: Clear Space Maintained
gates.rule: The logo's defined clear space is empty on all four sides.

gates.title: Minimum Size Respected
gates.rule: The logo is not used below its stated minimum, and is legible at the size it actually renders.

gates.title: No Unauthorised Logo Modification
gates.rule: No recolouring, no stretching, no re-proportioning, no effects added.

gates.title: Brand Palette Only
gates.rule: No colour outside the brand palette, with the primary/secondary/accent ratio roughly 60/30/10.

gates.title: Brand Fonts, Correct Weights
gates.rule: The brand's faces at the weights the guidelines name, with the hierarchy the guidelines set.

gates.title: Imagery Matches The Brand Style
gates.rule: Subject, treatment, and editing match the established photographic style, and everything used is licensed.

gates.title: Voice Matches The Brand
gates.rule: Tone matches the brand personality and the context, terminology and capitalisation follow the style guide, and no prohibited term appears.

gates.title: Message Aligns To The Framework
gates.rule: The value proposition is clear, differentiators are present, benefits lead over features, and nothing contradicts the messaging framework.

gates.title: No Orphans Or Widows In Set Copy
gates.rule: No single word stranded on its own line at the end of a paragraph or headline in fixed-layout output.

gates.title: Claims Are Supportable
gates.rule: No misleading claim, no unsourced superlative, pricing accurate, required disclosures present.

gates.title: Third-Party Material Is Cleared
gates.rule: Stock imagery licensed, audio cleared, no trademark used without right, credits present where required.
